note: Reproducibility repeats: each repeat's state from the snapshot of v3.db (queued: no match yet; running; stopped; complete: every pair playable today finished), the matches finished of the pairs playable today, and each original's own decisions and billed cost on the pairs its repeat plays (once complete: exactly the pairs it finished) beside the repeat's on the same pairs (same seeds and dice); the repeats are held setups, in no standings, table or other setup's numbers.

differences: Name: '<original> [repeat 1]', a new players row; settings otherwise as the original's (the changed fields are listed under Settings); one match at a time, as the original (start.sh, max_matches 1).

Runner: the original ran dab6da5 (clean) for its first stage (#993-#1013) and 38024d6 (clean; map-check v2 and the raw_entries decoder) for its local stage (#1053-#1063), both on origin/main's runner line (ca112dc); the repeat runs 959a8a2 (branch pinned-late-gemini): the repeats' runner 0e66836 (late-reax line with the pinned-pairs change 4ca4f08 and admit) with those four runner commits cherry-picked (cb669a0) and the run guard (c13992f, 959a8a2: reply identity and the shared pre-send cap, used with --guard only). late-reax adds decision clients (reax, baselabs, drex, nace) and a budget ledger, which the run guard uses; requests, sampling (provider defaults, nothing set), the prompt version, option-order seed and rules are the same.

Map check: map-check v2 (a probability map that is not exactly the shown ids, finite in [0, 1], summing to 1 within 1e-6, stores no probabilities; the returned choice is still played) applies to every repeat pair; the original's first-stage pairs (#993-#1013, dab6da5) ran without it. Plays are not affected; a first-stage pair can store probabilities in the original where the repeat stores none.

Hosted model: Gemini Decision 1 is served by Google AI Studio through OpenRouter. The repeat accepts a reply only when it names the original's served model google/gemini-decision-1-20261111 and provider Google AI Studio (as all 1,704 original decisions did); a model served under that same name but changed behind it cannot be detected from here.

Route check: the original's guard re-checked OpenRouter's listing every minute (3 failures stopped it); the repeat checks it once before the first match (smoke) and, in the runner (run guard), the served identity of every entrant reply: model google/gemini-decision-1-20261111 and provider Google AI Studio exactly, or the guard latches and the league stops for good. Fallbacks stay off.

Cap: the original's $5 entry cap with $1.1819 recorded (a minute poll of stored turns); the repeat's run guard holds the entrant and paid opponents to the remaining $3.8181 before every request attempt (see cost_basis).
